name: Methotrexate
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 7.5 mg once weekly IM to start; adjust to response (label); oral 2.5 mg tablets in PH, once weekly
10 to 25 mg once weekly IM or IV; reduce to the lowest effective dose
Regimen-specific; high-dose regimens with hydration, urine alkalinization, levels and leucovorin

key_interactions.effect: Higher methotrexate levels; severe gastrointestinal toxicity, especially at high dose (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid with high-dose; monitor closely with low-dose.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Penicillins, sulfonamides including trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, probenecid, proton pump inhibitors
key_interactions.action: Avoid if possible; otherwise monitor blood counts and levels.

serious: Fatal toxicity from daily instead of weekly dosing

pk.half_life: 3 to 10 hours (low dose); 8 to 15 hours (high dose)
pk.metabolism: Hepatic and intracellular to polyglutamates (active, retained in cells)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 80% to 90% of IV dose unchanged in urine within 24 hours
pk.dialyzability: Moderate by intermittent HD (EXTRIP); limited clinical benefit
